name: fourier
bio: Fourier is an AI-Powered Payment Collection Assistant

Fourier is a Discord-based AI agent that simplifies crypto payment collection by combining form data gathering with payment processing on the Sui blockchain. Through natural conversation, users can quickly create customized payment collection links that gather both payment and required information from customers.
Key Features:
- Conversational AI interface via Discord for easy payment link creation
- Customizable form fields to collect customer information
- Automated payment collection using USDC on Sui blockchain
- Simple sharing via generated payment links
- Real-time payment tracking and notifications
- Secure data collection and storage
How It Works:
1. Users interact with the AI agent in Discord to specify their payment collection needs
2. The agent generates a unique payment link with customized form fields
3. Customers fill out the required information and complete payment through a streamlined interface
4. All data and payments are securely processed and stored on the Sui blockchain
5. Users receive instant notifications of completed payments
Use Cases:
- Event ticket sales with attendee information collection
- Product pre-orders with customer details
- Service bookings with client questionnaires
- Membership registrations with profile data
- Course enrollments with student information
